I am an older woman with a small piece of land here in Kilimanjaro, and I have learned to farm carefully with what I have. This plot is only 0.06 hectares, so I will work it with my family and use manure from our animals to keep the soil fertile, but I will not spend money on chemical fertilizer or hired labor for such a small patch. I have kept my own seed from last season, and since the plot is intercropped and not very big, my family and I can weed it by hand without needing sprays or irrigation.
